Package model.characters

Class Character

java.lang.Object
model.characters.Character
Direct Known Subclasses:
Hero, Zombie
public abstract class Character extends Object
Abstract base for all entities on the game map (heroes and zombies). Manages the core combat attributes — HP, location, attack damage, and target — and defines the shared attack() / defend(Character) contract. Death handling (onCharacterDeath()) clears the entity from the map and triggers a UI refresh via Game.onMapUpdate.
